pages.text: A gravitational wave of strain h changes the arms' lengths by ±hL/2, and the light returning to the beam splitter interferes a little differently. Four noises hide it. Shot noise - the graininess of light - falls as 1/(F√P) with the arms' finesse F and the laser power P; radiation-pressure noise - the photons' kicks on the mirrors - rises as F√P: where they are equal is the standard quantum limit. Each isolation stage cuts the ground's shaking tenfold; the thermal jiggling of the mirrors falls as √T.
$(thing)Set$(): Laser power P, Arm finesse F, Isolation stages.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Microseism: the ground shakes by ±50%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The ground shakes too hard: the arms cannot hold lock.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A clearer detection is faster; every isolation stage makes locking slower.

$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Shot noise: h_shot ∝ 1/(F√P)$(br)Radiation-pressure noise: h_rp ∝ F√P$(br)Seismic noise: h_seis ∝ ground · 10⁻ⁿ$(br)Thermal noise: h_th ∝ √T$(br)Total noise: h_n = √Σh²$(br)Signal to noise: SNR = h/h_n
